event.proposal: Family: training control. Retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100.00%, margin 1.00 percentage point over 99%. Most recent same-family evidence is attempt-0003, an infrastructure/optimization error with no score; prior attempts in this family: 3. This is a genuine 4-step bounded training run with reduced 512-example batches, testing whether the earlier setup-cost failure was separable from candidate optimization; it is more informative than another 2-step run because it increases optimizer exposure while holding the data bound fixed. Acceptance and rollback remain runner-controlled.
